known_risks: truth is the id key, so key errors count either way
the one-to-one gain was first seen post hoc in X12's held-out regions; this test exists to confirm it on unseen regions
engine decision ids are not stable across rebuilds; edges are pinned by file
question: On English GP practices, does engine + nigeria-facility-decider-v1 + one-to-one find clearly more of the registries' twins than the engine, without losing agreement?

rule.baseline: engine matches under the same one-to-one rule
rule.interpretation: pass: the UK GP workflow ships as engine + nigeria decider + one-to-one with flags for review, no UK model; the X11/X12 held-out figures (99.86%/97.4%) become a consistent second look rather than the evidence. fail: report which bound
rule.metrics: precision = kept links joining a CQC location to its id twin / kept links whose CQC location has a twin among the region's RO76 practices; recall = twins linked / twins; twins_lost = twins matched before one-to-one but not after
rule.pass: precision >= engine precision - 0.001, and recall >= engine recall + 0.05, and twins_lost <= 0.1% of twins; pooled over the six regions
rule.pipeline: engine matches stand; held pairs decided by the bundle as shipped (located/hidden thresholds per pair); one-to-one: engine matches first by engine score, then decider matches by probability, ties by decision id; a link whose CQC location or ODS practice is already linked becomes a flag
rule.population: X12's edges (CQC GP locations vs ODS RO76 practices) in the six regions not held out by X11/X12: E12000001, E12000003, E12000004, E12000006, E12000007, E12000009
secondary: flag counts by kind and flags on twins
pairs still held and decider rejects
rule.why_fresh: the Nigerian decider never trained on UK data; X11 reported best-per-location linker figures on all nine regions with the full ODS population (not RO76, not one-to-one); X12 used these regions' engine-held pairs only to fit the UK arm, whose outcome is irrelevant here; no one-to-one figure for these regions has been computed
